title: Tagine-Style Steak with Herbs
description: A twist on traditional Italian steak, incorporating flavors from Tunisia and herbs.
instructions: Season the steak with salt, pepper, and ground cumin.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to the oven.
Baste the steak with chicken broth every 10 minutes for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Optional: serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad.
